FX-8BPC-001.says: 8 bpc: Fast Box Blur radius 2 (3 passes), then Exposure +6. The blur averages display values and its faint edge rounds to 0, so the light ends sooner than in Float (FX-FASTBOX-007), and nothing past white is kept.

FX-8BPC-002.says: 8 bpc: Gaussian Blur, Blurriness 4, then Exposure +6. The long faint tail that Float lights (FX-BLURRY-007) rounds to 0.

FX-8BPC-003.says: 8 bpc: Exposure -1 alone, worked in linear light, then rounded to 8 bits.

FX-8BPC-004.says: 8 bpc: Fast Box Blur radius 2 alone. Every value is a whole 255th in display values.

FX-8BPC-005.says: 8 bpc with no effect: the drawing untouched.
